notes.title: Exodition - Update #4
notes.content:
Version 0.8.01 
The fourth Update for Exodition is [b]out now![/b]

List of all the changes:

[h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Level 13[/b] - The urbans. The Place where the Sarath-Guards house and the place where you find new powers! 
[*] [b]New Level 14[/b] - The approach of the great Entrance Hall of Horidian with new Puzzles.
[*] [b]A new Mechanic!![/b] - The Storm-Dash with new Jumping-Dynamics as well as a new possible to interact with Horidians Obstacles. Solve the new Puzzles in your way. 
[*] [b]More story[/b] for you to experiece. Get to know a bit more about Horidian and Edom.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Created a hint for an obstacle at the Floating-Intersection 
[/list]

Please send me all feedback you have. I will troubleshoot [b]every problem[/b] as fast as I can!

Next Update will be in October! New levels , New functions!!

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
The second bigger Update for Exodition is here! Open for playing right now!

List of all the changes:

[h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Level 10[/b] - A huge flying car intersection in front of the Main station of horidian. Well packed with traps by the cruel Lorus. 
[*] [b]New Level 11[/b] - The Main station of Horidian - Run along the tracks but take care of the train-traffic!
[*] [b]New Secret Areas[/b] where you can find Statues of Edom-Wisdoms. 
[*] Keyboard-movement for French-Keyboard Layout
[*] [b]More story[/b] for you to experiece. Get to know a bit more about Horidian and Edom.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where jumping was impossible after reading a sign
[*] Discord and X button in main menu are now hover-animated
[*] A lot of smaller bugfixes throughout the game
[/list]


Thats it. Please send me all feedback you have. I will troubleshoot [b]every problem[/b] as fast as I can!

Next Update will be in August! New levels , New functions!!

Also: Dev-plays-the-game with QnA Stream in a few minutes from this update message - Come on by and say Hi: https://www.twitch.tv/exoditionworld

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
The very first big Update for Exodition is out! You can play it right now. 

Here is the list of all the changes: 

[h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Level 8[/b] - First stage of the second third of the Game. Out of the city Bottoms. Keep your head down for the flying cars all around you. 
[*] [b]New Level 9[/b] - THE FLIKIES FACTORY. 'The biggest Flikies Factory of Horidian' Conveyor Belts and Meat Grinders won't make your Factory-Tour easy. 
[*] [b]New Secret Areas[/b] where you can find Statues. I won't tell you too much about those as they are secrets for you to find <3 
[*] [b]Controller Support[/b] - Yes. A lot have asked for it, and with the current system I had to rework a lot of stuff, but now it is there ːsteamhappyː
[*] Options menu redone!
[*] [b]More story[/b] for you to experiece. Get to know a bit more about Horidian. 
[*] Sensitivity Option has been added
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Several Writing-Mistakes throughout the first 7 Levels
[*] Additional Level design in Level 2
[*] Wrong Steam-Requirements Information (4mb instead of 4gb RAM) 
[*] Got rid of short camera-glitches between cutscenes and gameplay
[*] Resolution wont change in options
[*] Options were only available in the Main-Menu. Now also in Ingame-Menu
[*] Issues on Settings-Loading
[*] Play time and Deaths are now shown at the end of the EA-Content
[*] Unachievable Steam-Achievements are temporary removed
[*] Electric Tower-Noises are now affected by the Master-Volume slider
[*] Credits have been refined a bit
[*] Save Name is now always in capitals
[*] Village house with collision issues fixed
[*] Settings can now be closed with ESC as they can be opened with that key
[*] In certain Levels you could see underneath the water. Now it is darkness <3
[*] Skip with G was shown on cutscenes, where you could only fast-forward. Now it is propperly declared
[/list]

Thats about it.. I think there may be a few I missed, but I can say that there may be some more things I havent fixed yet. But this is exactly what this Early Access is for. Please send me all feedback you have, so that I can put it on my todo and work it out asap =) [b]Your feedback count![/b]

I will make a little [b]Discount[/b] soon for the Exo-Fans out there who are unsure to pay 20 BuGs for an Early-Access Game.



For the Next Update on July 1st I would love to add Steam Achievements and there will be new levels with new challenges. 
Stay tuned

notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey folks, 
after releasing the demo a few days ago, there already have been a bunch of let's plays of Exodition uploaded on youtube. ːsteamhappyː 
Here is a playlist of all the videos: [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCx1AWjVYSirK7CjoQBFzm7g/playlists]Here[/url]

Some bugs have been noticed and so I thought of fixing them asap. 
Here is the list of fixes: 

[list]
[*] Transition issue between lvl 1 and 2. - fixed
[*] Some contents kept beeing saved after replaying the demo, causing some trouble in the second level. -fixed
[*] Statuecollecting - Danceanimation had a weird offset when jumping while collecting the statuepiece. -fixed
[*] Graphics and Sound settings have been added to the ingame menu.
[*] The watermonster-deathsound was too loud - slightly decreased
[*] Checkpoint-Crows havent been touched by the master sound volume. - fixed
[*] You could sneak slightly beside the spraying steam at one point - not anymore ːsteammockingː
[*] After respawning the Camera have been showing in the wrong direction - fixed
[*] Added social media links on the main menu
[/list]

If you have more feedback please let me know! There is a Support-Mail on the Shop page. Or you join the Exodition Discord: https://discord.gg/JduCN49
Have a nice play! =J
